mapping_notes:
Second local Omneum 1.0.3 run: multi-claim cases from the synthetic Tideline package
(R replaces chains with changing values, K conflict_with cases), via Cole's
local_evaluation adapter. No daemon, no MCP.

Mapping (same rules as measure.py, plus):
- every memory is its own Source; claim = (service, tideline-<entity>, attribute, value)
- replaces -> parent_assertion_ids; source -> upstream_sources only on exact string equality
- a conflict_with save was diverted into its target memory; its incoming claim is mapped as
  its own observation under the diverted save id (a separate internal resource), carrying
  the incoming source string, observed on the same day as the target.
